reasons: The three images successfully fulfill distinct functional roles within the editorial set: Image 1 focuses on the 'crop-identity overview' with young seedlings and a straight perspective; Image 2 provides 'agronomic close evidence' with a low angle showing a diverse mix of growing plants and flowers; and Image 3 offers the 'irrigation-system story' context with a wider landscape view including farm machinery and bare soil preparation.
